clue.text: Thus cover is substantial

parts.note: thus means so, as in 'and so it was'
a lid is a cover for a pot or box

explanation.surface: A remark that a certain kind of cover is hefty and solid-feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something solid is firm and sturdy, which is what substantial means here.

clue.text: Seen in menders, a ripped garment

indicators.note: the letters are visible inside the run of clue words menders, a ripped, so this signals a concealed word

explanation.surface: Repairers spot a torn piece of clothing brought in for mending.
explanation.definitionFit: A sari is the draped garment worn by women in South Asia.

clue.text: Abandoned port

definitions.meaning: abandoned as in deserted or gone away from
port is the nautical term for the ...-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A harbour that has been deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left behind has been abandoned; on a ship, port is the left side.

clue.text: Day going round Paris surprisingly different

indicators.note: the day word goes round the outside of the jumbled city letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a date is a particular day

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters of Paris come out in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A day spent touring Paris turns out unexpectedly unlike anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: The French capital contributes only its letters; nothing in the answer concerns France.
explanation.definitionFit: Disparate things are fundamentally unlike one another, i.e. distinct or different.

clue.text: Weakness of female feeling ill

parts.note: ailing means unwell or poorly

explanation.surface: Describes the frailty of a woman who is under the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A failing is a fault or shortcoming in someone's character, a weakness.

clue.text: Tricky to manage, like a violin?

definitions.meaning: a violin is a fiddle, so something fiddle-like is whimsically described with a -y ending; the question mark flags the made-up sense

explanation.surface: Suggests a violin is an awkward instrument to master.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiddly tasks need fine, awkward handling; the second sense jokes on fiddle as a violin.

clue.text: Form of belief exists, followed by millions

indicators.note: the word for exists comes first and the millions abbreviation follows it

parts.note: is means exists, as in 'there is'
M is the abbreviation for million(s)

explanation.surface: A creed is said to exist with millions of adherents.
explanation.definitionFit: An ism is any distinctive doctrine or ideology, a system of belief.

clue.text: Financially embarrassed home — that place sold finally

parts.note: in means at home, as in 'staying in'
there means at or in that place

indicators.note: finally picks only the closing letter of the word sold

explanation.surface: A cash-strapped owner's home, that place, has at last been sold.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the red means overdrawn or in debt, as debts were once written in red ink.

clue.text: In oily manner, putting off a girl, yes?

indicators.note: putting off is read as setting the letters of a girl, yes off into a new order

explanation.surface: A slimy suitor's smarmy approach puts a girl off, doesn't it?
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting off' looks like the smarmy man repelling the girl, but it is the signal to rearrange A, GIRL and YES.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something greasily means in a slick, smarmy or literally oily way.

clue.text: Didn't allow sports official to get employed

parts.note: ref is short for referee, a sports official
used means employed, as a tool is employed

explanation.surface: A referee was not permitted to take up a job.
explanation.definitionFit: If someone refused a request they would not permit it, so the sense is a synonym.

clue.text: Symbol of religious authority about to be given to US university

indicators.note: the word for about is handed over and placed after the university's initials

parts.note: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An emblem of church power is about to be donated to an American college.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's tall pointed headdress is worn as a sign of episcopal office.

clue.text: A lad mixed up with rebels who sing old songs?

definitions.note: the clue phrase stands for people who sing old songs, a plural noun

indicators.note: mixed up says the letters of a lad and rebels are jumbled together

explanation.surface: A youth falls in with rebels who sing traditional ballads?
explanation.definitionFit: Singers of narrative folk ballads are traditionally called by this name.

clue.text: Point made by management?

definitions.meaning: point as a verb or noun of aiming, the way something faces
management as in leadership or control of an enterprise

explanation.surface: Asks whether a point was raised by the bosses.
explanation.definitionFit: A direction is where something points, and also guidance or supervision from those in charge.

clue.text: Store with mass of stuff in Teesside location

parts.note: stock is a store or supply of goods
a ton is a large weight, or informally a huge amount

explanation.surface: A shop with heaps of goods in a northern English town.
explanation.walkthrough: Teesside is the area around the River Tees in north-east England; Stockton-on-Tees is one of its towns.
explanation.definitionFit: Stockton-on-Tees is a market town in the Teesside area of north-east England.

clue.text: Like something that matters about eastern part of Med

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the Levant is the old name for the lands of the eastern Mediterranean

explanation.surface: Something of importance concerning the eastern Mediterranean.
explanation.definitionFit: Relevant things bear on the matter in hand, so they matter, a descriptive synonym.

clue.text: Greek characters leaving the job unfinished

indicators.note: unfinished means the word for job loses its final letter

parts.note: a task is a job to be done

explanation.surface: Greek people walking out with the work left incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' drops the K from TASK. 'characters' means letters, not people.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is a letter of the Greek alphabet, so several of them are Greek characters.

clue.text: Gold trade offers a painful experience

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a deal is a trade or bargain

explanation.surface: Dealing in bullion turns out to be a miserable business.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a harrowing trial to be endured, a distressing experience.

clue.text: Rotten, like a horse prepared to ride, first to fall away

indicators.note: the opening letter of the horse word drops off

parts.words: like a horse prepared to ride
parts.note: a horse ready for riding has been saddled

explanation.surface: A horse made ready for riding turns out to be past it, the leader falling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to fall away' removes the S from SADDLED.
explanation.definitionFit: Addled eggs are rotten, gone bad and unfit to eat.

clue.text: Smart guy, the one sitting between Tom and Harry?

definitions.text: the one sitting between Tom and Harry?
definitions.meaning: the phrase Tom, Dick and Harry has Dick in the middle, here jokingly called the bright one

explanation.surface: A know-all seated between two friends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom, Dick and Harry' means ordinary people in general; the middle name is the joke here.
explanation.definitionFit: A clever dick is British slang for a smug know-all.

clue.text: Look for building that can accommodate any number

indicators.note: the building is said to hold the number letter inside it

parts.note: a hut is a small simple building
N is the algebra letter for any number

explanation.surface: Search for a structure with space for unlimited guests.
explanation.definitionFit: To hunt for something is to search for it.

clue.text: Study Yankee's to declare false

parts.note: a den is a private room or study
Yankee is Y in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Examine an American's claim to call it untrue.
explanation.definitionFit: To deny a statement is to assert that it is untrue.

clue.text: Male taken in by deception is one of no fixed abode

indicators.note: the male letter is drawn inside the deception word

parts.note: a trap is a trick or deception

explanation.surface: A man fooled by a con turns out to be homeless.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp is a vagrant who wanders without a home.

clue.text: Illustration of India engraved in copper

indicators.note: the India letter is cut into the copper letters, set inside them

parts.note: copper is slang for a policeman, and PC means police constable
India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An image of India etched into a copper plate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' looks like the metal (Cu) but is the police officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Pic is informal shorthand for a picture or photograph.

clue.text: Holiday? Get flowery garland, certainly

definitions.note: the noun stands for free time; the question mark admits the loose match

parts.note: a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers
sure means certainly, as in 'sure, I will'

explanation.surface: A holiday maker in Hawaii is promised a flower garland.
explanation.definitionFit: Leisure is free time away from work, which is what a holiday gives.

clue.text: Seen as a cake without topping

definitions.meaning: a cake with no icing on it is in the state of being plain, read as two words

explanation.surface: A plain cake has been spotted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something noticed has been spotted or observed.

clue.text: Refusal to keep dry and neat

indicators.note: the refusal word keeps the dry letters held inside it

parts.note: nay is an old word for no, a refusal
TT means teetotal, so dry as in not drinking alcohol

explanation.surface: Saying no to keep things tidy and dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Natty means smart and trim in appearance, so neat.
